notes: v3: Covers all 9 themes (canopy, saltflat, lightwell, obsidian, glasshouse, orbit, sahel, nocturne, zen) with zero Al Goldstein / Pandora collection files and zero duplicates from audio/music/manifest.json. Specifically names and quotes Paul Pitman's exact Wikimedia Commons pages for Salt Mirror (saltflat) and Nocturne (nocturne). Every entry quotes the Wikimedia Commons file page's Description, Source, Author, Date, and Permission lines verbatim.
